review_basis: Explicit coordinator instruction during the authorized public procurement research, followed by inspection of the existing source and request logs. This is routine scope control, not a new user-approval gate.
operational_import_state_at_change: Root confirms current plan not yet imported for the real run. Earlier architect imports were isolated scratch validation.
immutable_change_rule: Once any operational ledger has imported this definition, new access scope requires a new plan and task version/ID. Never edit the imported definition in place or silently extend an active claim.

parent_transaction.relationship_limit: Seller URLs were discovered by exact-part public searches, not hyperlinks asserted to appear in the award. No sale, supply-chain membership or approved-source relationship is inferred.

admissions.discovery_parent: Exact part/NSN search results recorded in research-market/query_log.json
admissions.business_domain_basis: Seller-owned public product page, observed in the source index; no account-only service is requested.
admissions.relevance: URL and indexed fields match part39-8820-501 and NSN5306004457358.
admissions.current_evidence: Two direct opens timed out. Indexed36units with a2025date do not establish current2243unit availability. No price acquired.
admissions.additional_path_rule: Only a newly observed exact-part document URL may become a seed after coordinator relevance review; do not infer paths.

admissions.discovery_parent: Exact-part seller-catalog search results recorded in research-market/sources.json
admissions.business_domain_basis: Seller-owned public document host observed in an indexed catalog pointer; no private financial or customer data requested.
admissions.relevance: Indexed catalog pointer matches the same exact part and NSN.
admissions.current_evidence: Historical indexed pointer only; original catalog, price, current date and quantity availability not acquired.
admissions.additional_path_rule: No general site crawl; any new item-specific URL needs recorded relevance before use.

common_limits.counting: Failures, retries and redirects count; these caps are inside existing task limits, not additional allowances.
exclude: bulk customer or price-list enumeration unrelated to the exact part

implementation_limit: Exact host names are imported into the runtime plan. Path and per-host byte/request caps must be applied in each bounded tracer input and reviewed manifest; the runtime host list alone does not enforce them. The tracer does not yet reserve the runtime ledger budget, so count actual manifest attempts in the coordinator record.
price_analysis_limit: Admission grants read-only source scope only; it does not establish independence, authentic historical terms, equivalent specification, executable price, payment, overcharge or buyer benefit.
